findings.title: Documented deprecated action readback alias prevents admission or leaves a partial batch
findings.cause: canonicalReaction spreads all Reaction keys, including deprecated action. Desired reactions contain actions only. Official Reaction documentation permits action and the official reactions getter example returns both the action alias and actions array. Redundant dual-field readback therefore compares unequal to the equivalent desired reaction.
findings.reproduction: Read-only in-memory fixture extensions using the supplied correction1 harness: adding action=deepCopy(actions[0]) to both existing menu reactions makes valid dual-field readback ABORTED_PREFLIGHT with Existing menu pair drift and0 writes. Keeping initial existing pair minimal but having each setter expose the same documented dual-field readback yields Reaction write mismatch, ROLLBACK_INCOMPLETE,1 write and the first control unresolved. No Figma call or input edit occurred.
findings.requested_change: Normalize the explicitly documented deprecated alias only when it is demonstrably redundant with the full sole actions[0], or safely support the documented action-only representation. Preserve and reject contradictory aliases and every meaningful optional Action/Trigger field. Keep rollback ownership on full actual snapshots after successful semantic admission. Add synthetic success cases for documented dual-field readback at preflight and after setters plus conflicting-alias denial; do not simply delete action blindly.
findings.limits: This is a demonstrated compatibility defect for an official documented readback shape, not evidence that the current live editor has that exact shape or that current Figma data is corrupt.
